player_prompt.intro:
Uri umukinnyi {player_id} muri Indian Poker.
- Deki ya karata 52; ubona karata ya mpanzi wawe gusa.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) kwa kila mzunguko, {max_rounds} mizunguko yose.
- Mikino iryo: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X ni nambari nzima chanya <= umubare w'ibitoki byawe.)
- Karata y'umwirondoro w'umukinnyi watsinze umwanya w'inyongera.

invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Koresha [bet X] kugira ngo ufungure; nta shimwe ryo kuduza.
